dashboard.title: Your clinic
dashboard.subtitle: Start with the people: invite the experts who work with you.
dashboard.emptyBody: Each person gets an email, accepts in their Eleva account and sets up their services in your clinic.

members.title: Team
members.description: Invite the experts who work at your clinic, and the people who help you run it.
members.services: {count, plural, =0 {No published services yet} one {# published service} other {# published services}}
members.seats: {used} of {cap} seats in use. A seat is in use when an expert has a published service.
members.seatsFull: All {cap} seats are in use. A seat frees up when an expert unpublishes their last service or leaves the team; then another expert can publish.
members.seatsOver: {used} experts have a published service; your plan includes {cap} seats. Everyone who is published stays published. Another expert can publish once fewer than {cap} seats are in use.
members.ownerNote: The owner always stays in the team, and is the only one who can add or remove admins. Admins manage the team, the clinic profile and billing. Experts offer services and run sessions.
members.invitedHeading: {count, plural, one {# invitation waiting} other {# invitations waiting}}

invite.title: Invite someone to {clinic}
invite.description: They get an email with a link to join. The invitation is valid for 7 days.

roleHelp.member: Offers services and runs sessions in this clinic.
roleHelp.admin: Offers services and runs sessions, and also manages the team, the clinic profile and billing.

invite.roleFixed: They join as an expert: they offer services and run sessions in this clinic. The owner can invite an admin.

inviteError.already-member: This person is already in your team. You'll find them in the list of people.
inviteError.limit: Your team has reached 200 people. Remove someone or withdraw an invitation first.
inviteError.owner-required: Only the owner can invite an admin or change an admin's invitation. Ask the owner to do it.
inviteError.recently-sent: You can send this invitation again in a minute.
inviteError.failed: We could not send the invitation. Please try again.

remove.title: Remove {name} from {clinic}?
remove.body: They lose access to this clinic right away, and their services here can no longer be booked. Their Eleva account stays as it is.

error.upcoming-sessions: {name} still has {count, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}} booked in this clinic. You can remove them once {count, plural, one {it is} other {they are}} done or cancelled.
error.owner: The owner always stays in the team.
error.self: You cannot remove your own account.
error.owner-required: Only the owner can remove an admin. Ask the owner to do it.
error.failed: We could not remove this person. Please try again.
error.pending-bookings: Someone is booking a session with {name} right now. Try again in a few minutes.

toast.emailNotSent: The invitation for {email} is saved, but the email could not be sent. Wait a minute, then use Send again.
toast.invitationGone: This invitation was already answered or withdrawn.
toast.removed: {name} is no longer in your team.
toast.memberGone: This person is no longer in your team.
toast.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

verification.title: Verification
verification.description: Eleva checks your clinic's legal name and tax number in the public register, so people can trust who is behind the clinic.

not-sent.title: Send your clinic's legal details
not-sent.body: We check them in the public company register. You do this once, and again only if they change.

checking.title: We are checking your details
checking.body: You do not need to do anything. This page shows the result as soon as the check is done.

change-needed.title: We need a change before we can verify your clinic
change-needed.body: Read what we found below, correct your details and send them again.

verified.title: Your clinic is verified
verified.body: We found your clinic's legal name and tax number in the public register.

verified-checking.title: Your clinic is verified, and we are checking your new details
verified-checking.body: Your clinic stays verified with the details we checked before. You do not need to do anything.

verified-change-needed.title: Your clinic is verified, and your new details need a change
verified-change-needed.body: Your clinic stays verified with the details we checked before. Read what we found below and send the new details again.

verified-new-rejected.title: Your clinic is verified, but we could not confirm your new details
verified-new-rejected.body: Your clinic stays verified with the details we checked before. Read what we found below.

not-verified.title: We could not verify your clinic with these details
not-verified.body: Read what we found below. You can correct your details and send them again.

form.heading: Your clinic's legal details
form.correctHelp: You can correct what you sent while we are checking it.
form.headingChanged: Has your legal name or tax number changed?
form.changedHelp: Send the new details. Your clinic stays verified while we check them.
form.taxIdHelp: As it appears on your invoices, for example PT515001708.
form.use: We use these details to check your clinic's legal identity.
form.sent: Details sent. We are checking them.

errors.invalid-tax-id: Enter a valid NIF or VAT number: 8 to 32 letters and digits, for example PT515001708.
errors.validation: Check both fields and try again.
errors.changed: Your details were updated while you were sending. Reload the page and try again.
errors.failed: We could not send your details. Please try again.
